description: This is a Java interface defining the service layer for Product-related business operations in a backend application.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Interface for product-related business logic, including create, findAll, findById, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product and returns the created entity with its generated ID.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all products.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a product by its ID, returns an Optional<Product>.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with new product data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product by its ID.
